design_description: A refined monochrome design built around subtle tonal striping for a premium, understated look. Alternating matte black and charcoal vertical stripes create depth without overpowering the shirt, while a faint herringbone texture adds extra sophistication. Gold detailing on the collar, sleeve cuffs, logos, and crest provides an elegant contrast and reinforces the luxury aesthetic. The clean composition avoids unnecessary graphics, letting the texture and stripe rhythm define the jersey's identity. Overall, the design feels timeless, modern, and premium—ideal for a club seeking a sleek, high-end appearance.
